scope: Independent startup-conditioning hypotheses for the 6 g pentyl propanoate bed. No reactor conversion is used to select properties, exposure factors or model settings.

batch.location: Lorenzo and Ortega (2026), experimental procedure and Table 1
batch.sequence: 29.7 mL 1-pentanol and the immobilised lipase are heated together before addition of 10.3 mL propanoic acid.

packed_bed.sequence: The jacketed cartridge receives the premixed pentanol and acid feed after it reaches the setpoint.

moisture_isotherms.citation: Kuroiwa et al. (2015), Journal of Food Research 4(5), 133–143
moisture_isotherms.location: Section 2.5, Eq. 4, Figure 6 and Table 1 (printed p. 139), enzyme rows
moisture_isotherms.method: Closed-vial water equilibration; liquid Karl Fischer titration and water inventory balance, accounting for initial solid moisture. Acetone data from Kuroiwa et al. (2007), reproduced and fitted in this article.
moisture_isotherms.interpretation: The sorbed water q in kg/kg preparation follows q_max*c/(K+c) with c in kg/m3 (numerically g/L). The measurement is an equilibrium endpoint, not a time constant. No fitted parameter uncertainty is printed. The reacting pentanol/propanoic acid/ester mixture has no measured isotherm here.

time_proxy_digitization.interpretation: Linear interpolation between plotted markers at equal conversion; use the smaller of the two fresh-time/reuse-time ratios as a mild apparent time-scale sensitivity. This is not a measured intrinsic activity ratio or a confidence interval.

same_alcohol_reuse.transfer: Same alcohol and commercial preparation, different carboxylic acid. Stable conversion times under this reuse procedure do not ensure stability under propanoic acid.

propanoic_acid_contact.citation: Meneses et al. (2019), Bioprocess and Biosystems Engineering
propanoic_acid_contact.location: Article Table 1; equivalent author thesis Chapter 3 Table 7, printed p. 53, PDF p. 54
propanoic_acid_contact.specimen: Novozym 435, propanoic acid and benzyl alcohol
propanoic_acid_contact.activity_assay: Lauric acid and n-propanol 1:1, 5% enzyme, 60 °C, 40 min, triplicate. Activities in U/g immobilised catalyst; the statistic of the quoted plus/minus values is not identified in the table.
propanoic_acid_contact.reuse_conditions: Two 24 h fed-batch cycles at 50 °C, 150 rpm, 10 wt% immobilised enzyme relative to substrates, molecular sieves; acid added over the first 5 h. Acetone washing three times and overnight drying at 50 °C between cycles.
propanoic_acid_contact.transfer: Independent residual-activity endpoints in a different alcohol and on a different reaction assay, with separate neat-solvent contacts. The actual bed receives a premixed 2:1 feed. No deactivation constant or conditioned fraction for that bed can be inferred.

bed_time_trace.location: Figure S2, filled circles (pentyl propanoate, alcohol:acid 2)
bed_time_trace.use: Independent check of startup drift in the plotted run, not a calibration series. No assignment to a specific member of the 20-run grid. The marker reading spread is not experimental uncertainty.

transient_screen.description: Conditional spherical water storage calculation using the reported geometry and aqueous wet porosity, then the nitrogen-based dry porosity as a sensitivity. Instantaneous reversible equilibrium with the local water concentration; no intrabead water-activity history or actual enzyme deactivation law is inferred.

scenario_notes.bed_activity_scaling: Uniform apparent relative activity sensitivities applied once in the previous central film model, constant per run. The reported 6 g mass and internal effectiveness convention are retained; no rate factor is fitted to the reactor.
scenario_notes.nominal_exposure_scale: Use the prior concentration-basis audit's void fraction (0.64) only as a magnitude illustration. It comes from the bulk-volume versus void-volume rate convention, not a fitted activity. A permanent loss, a continuing first-order loss, and a recovering initial deficit at 30 min are different unvalidated histories.
